note: Inline Styled Images has no admin settings page and no configure route (configure=null). All configuration lives on a text format: enabling one of two filters (filter_imagestyle 'Display image styles' / filter_responsive_image_style 'Display responsive images') and selecting the allowed styles under filters..settings.image_styles. The CKEditor 5 plugins then write data-image-style / data-responsive-image-style onto , and the reversible filter swaps that for a themed image_style / responsive_image at render time. Medium cases create a text format with a filter pre-configured and ask the agent to read back the enabled styles; hard cases give a format with the filter disabled and require the agent to enable it and select a style, verified against the live filter.format config. Uses existing image styles (thumbnail, large) and responsive image styles (narrow, wide) present on the site.

evals.prompt: On a Drupal 11 site with the inline_responsive_images (Inline Styled Images) module, there is no module settings page. How do I make image styles selectable in the CKEditor 5 image dialog, and which text-format filter do I turn on to do it?
evals.expected_output: There is no configure route. On the text format (Configuration > Content authoring > Text formats and editors) enable the 'Display image styles' filter (filter_imagestyle) or 'Display responsive images' filter (filter_responsive_image_style) and tick the styles to expose. The CKEditor 5 plugin then adds a style dropdown to the image toolbar.

evals.prompt: When an editor picks an image style for an inline image with inline_responsive_images, what HTML attribute is written onto the tag, and what happens to it when the content is rendered?
evals.expected_output: The CKEditor 5 plugin stores the chosen style id in a data-image-style attribute (or data-responsive-image-style for responsive styles). The reversible filter reads that attribute plus the file's data-entity-uuid at render time and replaces the tag with a themed image_style / responsive_image derivative.

evals.prompt: Does the inline_responsive_images module have a central admin configuration page, or is it configured per text format? Where is the list of allowed image styles stored in configuration?
evals.expected_output: It has no configuration page (configure=null). It is configured per text format; the allowed styles are stored under filter.format.<format>.filters.<filter_id>.settings.image_styles as a map of style_id: style_id.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site there is a text format named 'iri_eval' that uses the inline_responsive_images 'Display image styles' filter. Inspect the live text-format configuration and list which image styles are enabled for that filter.
evals.expected_output: The iri_eval format has filter_imagestyle enabled with settings.image_styles = {thumbnail, large}. Read filter.format.iri_eval.filters.filter_imagestyle.settings.image_styles.

evals.prompt: A text format named 'iri_reval' on this site uses the inline_responsive_images 'Display responsive images' filter. Inspect the live configuration and state which responsive image styles are made available to editors by that filter.
evals.expected_output: The iri_reval format has filter_responsive_image_style enabled with settings.image_styles = {narrow, wide}. Read filter.format.iri_reval.filters.filter_responsive_image_style.settings.image_styles.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site there is a text format 'iri_task' where the inline_responsive_images 'Display image styles' filter (filter_imagestyle) is present but disabled. Enable that filter on the iri_task format and configure it to offer the 'thumbnail' image style to editors. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In filter.format.iri_task, filter_imagestyle has status: true and settings.image_styles includes at least one style (e.g. thumbnail: thumbnail). Set the filter config and save the format.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site there is a text format 'iri_rtask' where the inline_responsive_images 'Display responsive images' filter (filter_responsive_image_style) is present but disabled. Enable that filter on the iri_rtask format and configure it to offer the 'wide' responsive image style to editors. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In filter.format.iri_rtask, filter_responsive_image_style has status: true and settings.image_styles includes at least one responsive style (e.g. wide: wide). Set the filter config and save the format.
